summary: Bail denial under UAPA; Section 43D(5) restrictions; membership in banned organization insufficiency without overt act; delay in trial considered; reliance on K.A. Najeeb, Thwaha Fasal, Angela Harish Sontakke; charges not yet framed; electronic evidence from searches; prosecution alleges Maoist links; appeal allowed for bail.
